create_wiki_split_metric: create a WikiSplit metric to evaluate text simplification quality using SARI, BLEU, and exact match scores
compute_sari_score: compute SARI score for text simplification by comparing source, predicted, and reference sentences
compute_sacrebleu_score: compute SacreBLEU score for evaluating machine translation predictions against reference sentences
compute_exact_match: compute exact match score between predicted and reference sentences with normalized text comparison
normalize_text: normalize sentences by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace for consistent comparison
